post.summary: Create only for the durable Account first-dispatch winner
post.description: Requires internal.identity.user.create. first_attempt=true is the trusted Account attestation of the single durable grant; it is not derived from an absent identity lookup. Replayed first requests cannot dispatch again. first_attempt=false can recover an already correlated result but cannot initiate creation. Missing attestation is rejected. Unknown dispatch or missing process proof cannot justify compensation.

password_handle.description: Opaque existing binding; empty selects the handle already bound to this exact operation.

201.description: Confirmed correlated subject; JSON subject string.

400.description: Malformed request or missing explicit first_attempt.

403.description: Workload lacks the unchanged exact create permission.

409.description: Binding conflict or username conflict. This status never carries canonical never-dispatched compensation proof.

410.description: IDENTITY_CREATE_NOT_DISPATCHED is the original explicit proof, eligible only for the matching durable first winner and unchanged attempt version. PASSWORD_REFERENCE_INVALID is generic expiry or missing reference and cannot authorize compensation. The code and canonical410 status must both match.

500.description: Directory failure or unknown remote acknowledgement; retain correlation recovery.

503.description: IDENTITY_CREATE_UNCONFIRMED or existing bounded password precheck capacity failure; no automatic redispatch.
